name: filters unsorted tagged points before computing fixed-count windows
input: mixed tags and timestamp order with the published fixed-count value sequence
test:
points = [(3, 10, {'ml'}), (0, -1, {'ml'}), (1, 2, {'ml'}), (2, -10, {'ml'}), (4, 100, {'ml'}), (5, 999, {'other'})]
before = list(points)
assert fixed_count_moving_sums(points, 'ml', 2) == [1, -8, 0, 110]
assert points == before

name: uses half-open complete time windows with duplicate timestamps
input: tagged timestamps zero, two, five, five, and six
test:
points = [(5, 10, {'x'}), (0, 1, {'x'}), (2, 2, {'x'}), (5, 3, {'x'}), (6, 4, {'x'}), (7, 999, {'other'})]
assert time_window_moving_sums(points, 'x', 2) == [1, 2]
assert time_window_moving_sums(points, 'x', 1) == [1, 2, 13, 13]
assert fixed_count_moving_sums(points, 'missing', 1) == []
assert time_window_moving_sums(points, 'missing', 1) == []

name: rejects malformed points and invalid window settings
input: invalid tags, windows, timestamps, values, and point records
test:
def must_raise(call):
    try:
        call()
    except ValueError:
        return
    raise AssertionError('expected ValueError')
valid = [(0, 1.0, {'x'})]
must_raise(lambda: fixed_count_moving_sums(valid, '', 1))
must_raise(lambda: fixed_count_moving_sums(valid, 'x', 0))
must_raise(lambda: time_window_moving_sums(valid, 'x', False))
must_raise(lambda: fixed_count_moving_sums([(0, float('nan'), {'x'})], 'x', 1))
must_raise(lambda: fixed_count_moving_sums([('0', 1, {'x'})], 'x', 1))
must_raise(lambda: fixed_count_moving_sums([(0, 1, 'x')], 'x', 1))
must_raise(lambda: fixed_count_moving_sums([(0, 1)], 'x', 1))
